scope: Shared fields, exams, journey and generic site imagery; research-only implementation hand-off.
method: Cached file-specific Commons imageinfo metadata, file license pages, broad visual contact sheets and a second image/crop inspection at 1280px or above for each ready item. CC0 photograph dedication only; do not label this a blanket guarantee about all third-party rights.
